about: Extension notices (crates/proto/src/notice.rs): `compact` is the status strip's reading of a notice (compact_notice); `strip` is what a transcript text part reads as once notices an older harness streamed into the reply are dropped (strip_reply_notices; expect null = the part is untouched, "" = the whole part goes). The iPhone twin (apps/ios/Cypher/Session/NoticeText.swift, NoticeTextTests) runs these too.

compact.name: unknown window keeps its raw name
other notice keeps its first line
compact.text:
Claude bridge: 2 tool handler(s) still waiting
provider may be stuck
compact.expect: Claude bridge: 2 tool handler(s) still waiting

compact.name: not the pattern
compact.text: Claude rate limit warning: lots used
compact.expect: Claude rate limit warning: lots used

compact.name: extra text after the pattern
compact.text: Claude rate limit warning: 58% used (seven_day) soon
compact.expect: Claude rate limit warning: 58% used (seven_day) soon

strip.name: glued before the reply
strip.text: Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day)Let me look.

strip.name: own line before the reply
strip.text:
Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day)
Let me look.

strip.name: own line after the reply
strip.text:
Done.
Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day)

strip.name: two in a row
strip.text: Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day)Claude rate limit warning: 60% used (seven_day)Hi

strip.name: quoted inside the reply
strip.text: The bridge says "Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day)" near the cap.

strip.name: inside a sentence
strip.text: A Claude rate limit warning: 57% used (seven_day) B
